title: Clarify CommandCenterUI attention and Project Updater labels
description: Replace the ambiguous Needs you header with Attention needed and use the spaced Project Updater product name in all operator-visible UI copy, while preserving internal identifiers and behavior. Superseded by TASK-254, which owns independent review and release of the combined final UI state because later serial edits overwrote the earlier worktree snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: The collapsible sidebar header uses clear attention-oriented wording.
Operator-visible Project Updater labels and messages use the spaced name without changing internal identifiers.
Live and installer code remains equivalent and focused checks pass.
